messages:
release-mgr: Kicking off region-by-region rollout for runtime v3.4.0 — target path US -> EU -> APAC. Plan: 10% slice increments, 30m holdpoints, canary smoke, metric gates. Holdpoints: p99 < 300ms, error-rate < 0.25%, thermal events none

deploy-bot: [init] starting rollout for v3.4.0
```
deploy-bot: canary create --region us-west1 --slice 0.10 --version v3.4.0
status: accepted, run_id=rb-5467891230-canary
logs: pulling image, warming caches
```

alice: quick capacity check — us-west1 warm pool 130 GPUs (reserved 100 for prod), autoscale cushion +15% available. Baseline qps ~24k, tail traffic OK.

ben: pinging perf suite for short run. KV cache hit-rate prewarm: 68% (expect ~85% after priming). Running load-50k short.

carla: pin fallback version v3.3.9 in EU (eu-west2) config just in case. Added pin in rollout policy: fallback_version: v3.3.9

sre-ops: noted. Also enabling extra tracing for model shards in EU during rollout. Keeping extra retention 30m for traces.

deploy-bot: canary traffic shifted to 10% (us-west1). Observability hooks enabled.

alice: smoke tests: generation sanity and function calls ok. p50/p95/p99: 35ms / 148ms / 210ms. No errors in 1000 sample requests. :thumbsup:

ben: perf run (50k): p95 trending +10% after 5k requests — likely KV cache warmup. Continuing monitor.

release-mgr: holding at US holdpoint (30m). Monitoring channels: eng-sre, eng-runtime. If metrics breach, we will either throttle slice or roll back EU pin as fallback.

deploy-bot: scheduled next step -> eu-west2 slice 10% at T+40m pending holdpoint clearance.

eng-infra: FYI, thermal headroom in eu-west2 is slightly lower today due to maintenance; margin ~8% vs normal 20%. Recommend slower ramp in EU and reduce burst cap.

carla: noted. Change window update: EU ramp to 5% initial with 15m hold then evaluate before moving to 10%. I updated the rollout policy in the console.

release-mgr: good catch @eng-infra. Update plan: US -> stabilize -> EU 5% -> observe 15m -> if ok, EU -> 10% -> observe -> APAC 10%.

deploy-bot: executing EU priming per new plan.
```
deploy-bot: canary create --region eu-west2 --slice 0.05 --version v3.4.0 --hold 15m
status: accepted, run_id=rb-5467891230-eu-1
```

alice: EU 5% smoke: initial p95 190ms, p99 330ms (higher than expected). Error-rate 0.18%. Traces show KV cache miss storm on specific prefix.

ben: digging into KV pattern, looks like a small subset of customers hitting long sequences causing cache churn. Suggest prefix warming for high-freq keys and temporarily pin those customers to EU fallback pool if they spike.

eng-infra: thermal events detected in eu-west2 rack cluster-19: small throttle (GPU freq scaled down) at 5467891500. Impacting tail latency. Reducing slice to 2% now.

deploy-bot: traffic adjusted: eu-west2 slice -> 0.02 per infra request.

carla: switching EU fallback: rolling EU traffic back to v3.3.9 for the high-volume customer segments. Pin applied to routes /customer/* (sticky routing).

release-mgr: decision: hold EU ramp, keep EU at 2% for 30m while infra triages thermal. Continue US stabilization. APAC paused until EU healthy. Documenting as rollback-structured fallback (not full global rollback).

alice: confirming recent EU traces — thermal throttle coincides with p99 spike. After slice reduction p99 dropped back toward 250-280ms. We'll keep enhanced tracing.

ben: applied prefix warmers for the top 5 hot prefixes; async priming running. Expect KV hit-rate to improve from 68% -> ~82% in ~10m.

eng-infra: working on throttling policy to avoid rack-level downshifts. Ops will drain cluster-19 load to neighboring racks over next 20m, throttles will be reversed as thermal sensors stabilize.

deploy-bot: US canary now at 10% stable for 40m, promoting to regional ramp: us-west1 -> 30% now. eu-west2 remains pinned at 2% with fallback. apac scheduled but on hold.

release-mgr: rolling notes update: added incident note for eu-west2 thermal event, action taken: reduce EU slice, pin fallback to v3.3.9 for hot-routes, priming started, infra drain in progress. No full rollback required.

carla: adding post-rollout checklist item: verify KV cache stabilization and trace retention snapshot stored to /shared/rollouts/5467891230-eu-thermal.json

alice: monitoring dashboards look good for US after promotion: errors steady, p99 under 260ms.

ben: KV hit-rate after priming: 81% — traffic patterns look stable.

eng-infra: cluster-19 thermal metrics restored to normal threshold at 5467891600. Re-enabling normal GPU freq, removing emergency throttle.

release-mgr: EU ramp plan: after infra confirm, increase EU from 2% -> 5% for 15m -> 10% if gates pass. Will coordinate final APAC timing after EU 10% stable.

deploy-bot: queued eu-west2 ramp to 5% at T+55m if no regressions.

sre-ops: make sure to tag the run with rollback-criteria: sustained p99 > 320ms for 10m OR error-rate > 0.5% for 5m triggers automatic rollback to v3.3.9.

release-mgr: agreed. Thanks team — good cautious ops. I'll keep this thread updated and write up the postmortem inputs after the rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
